assumptions.choice: 'Capital' in the 1% order-size formula and the 5% risk caps is the current portfolio value (self.broker.getvalue()), not initial cash or available cash
assumptions.reason: spec says 'capital' without specifying which balance; portfolio value is the standard dynamic risk base

assumptions.choice: 'current price' in the size formula floor(1% of capital / current price) is the latest bar Close (self.data.close[0])
assumptions.reason: spec does not distinguish between the limit price and market price; Close is the most recent observable price

assumptions.choice: The first/last 30-minute exclusion window blocks only new quote placement (entries); stop-protection, take-profit fills, and timeout-driven market closes remain active at all times
assumptions.reason: the rule is stated as a bar filter on 'trading' in the context of the quoting workflow; disabling risk-exit logic during the window would leave open risk unmanaged, which the spec does not intend

assumptions.choice: Assumed standard US equity session 09:30-16:00, so excluded windows are 09:30-10:00 and 15:30-16:00
assumptions.reason: spec references 'first and last 30 minutes of the session' without giving explicit session bounds

assumptions.choice: Initial Buy/Sell limit quotes have no stated expiration and remain live (GTC) until filled or until cancelled by the opposing fill; only the take-profit ('opposing') order is subject to the 1-bar timeout
assumptions.reason: spec's timeout rule explicitly says 'the opposing order', scoping it to the post-fill take-profit order, not the initial quotes

assumptions.choice: Compared bar Close (self.data.close[0]) against the current Bollinger Band boundary, rather than intrabar High/Low
assumptions.reason: spec says 'price moves ... beyond the Bollinger Band' without specifying High/Low/Close; Close is used consistently elsewhere in the spec (e.g. ATR/Close)

assumptions.choice: When both stop-protection and TP-timeout conditions could fire on the same bar, stop-protection is checked and applied first
assumptions.reason: spec does not state a priority; capital-protection stop is treated as higher priority than the timeout-close mechanism

assumptions.choice: Total value of open limit orders and positions computed as sum(|order size| x order price) over all live orders plus |position size| x Close, used identically for both the Quoting-section '<5%' gate and the Risk-management '>5%' cap
assumptions.reason: the two spec statements describe the same quantity from two angles; a single consistent formula was used to satisfy both

assumptions.choice: 'Within 1 bar' and 'on the next bar' language is implemented using backtrader's standard one-bar order-processing lag (an order submitted in next() at bar N is matched against bar N+1 data)
assumptions.reason: this is the environment's native execution mechanics, not an added simplification, and is the closest literal reading achievable in backtrader
